title: Human Responsibility
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Human responsibility means that every person is accountable to God for worship, obedience, stewardship, and response to His truth. People are creatures under God’s authority, not autonomous judges over Him.
summary: Human responsibility means that every person is accountable to God for worship, obedience, stewardship, and response to His truth. People are creatures under God’s authority, not autonomous judges over Him.
christFocus: Jesus Christ reveals true human obedience and calls all people to repent, believe, and follow Him. Through Christ, sinners are forgiven for failed responsibility and restored to faithful obedience before God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Human beings are morally accountable creatures. God made people with responsibility before Him, and every person must give account to the Lord. Life is not lived outside His sight.

Responsibility includes worship, obedience, stewardship, love of neighbor, response to truth, and repentance when confronted by sin. People are not free to define good and evil apart from the Creator.

Sin often tries to escape responsibility through blame, hiding, excuses, comparison, or denial. From the fall onward, fallen people resist accountability while still remaining accountable before God.

The Gospel does not remove responsibility; it answers human failure through Christ and restores believers to faithful obedience. Grace forgives sinners and trains them to live before God with reverence and love.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
A culture of excuse-making cannot heal the human soul. People need compassion, but they also need truth. Human responsibility reminds believers that choices, desires, words, and actions matter before God.

This doctrine also guards against hopeless shame. Accountability before God is serious, but Christ provides mercy for repentant sinners and power to walk in new obedience.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Stop hiding behind blame, fear, or comparison. Bring your life honestly before God, confess what is yours to confess, and respond to His truth with repentance and faith. Live each day as one who will give account to Christ, trusting His grace to forgive and transform you.
